mapper.sql: p.PRODUCT_ID, p.PRODUCT_CODE, p.PRODUCT_NAME, p.PRODUCT_TYPE, p.CATEGORY_ID, p.ISSUER, p.CURRENCY_CODE, p.MIN_INVESTMENT_AMOUNT, p.MAX_INVESTMENT_AMOUNT, p.EXPECTED_RETURN_RATE, p.RISK_LEVEL, p.INVESTMENT_TERM, p.TERM_UNIT, p.SUBSCRIPTION_START_DATE, p.SUBSCRIPTION_END_DATE, p.EARLY_REDEMPTION, p.PRODUCT_STATUS, p.SHELF_STATUS, p.DESCRIPTION, p.REMARK, p.ORG_ID, p.CREATE_TIME, p.CREATE_BY, p.UPDATE_TIME, p.UPDATE_BY, c.CATEGORY_NAME
mapper.select: SELECT FROM TBL_FINANCIAL_PRODUCT p LEFT JOIN TBL_FINANCIAL_CATEGORY c ON p.CATEGORY_ID = c.CATEGORY_ID WHERE p.PRODUCT_ID = #{productId}
SELECT FROM TBL_FINANCIAL_PRODUCT p LEFT JOIN TBL_FINANCIAL_CATEGORY c ON p.CATEGORY_ID = c.CATEGORY_ID WHERE p.CATEGORY_ID = #{categoryId} ORDER BY p.CREATE_TIME DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) as total, SUM(CASE WHEN PRODUCT_STATUS = 'ACTIVE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as activeCount, SUM(CASE WHEN SHELF_STATUS = 'ON' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as onShelfCount FROM TBL_FINANCIAL_PRODUCT
AND ORG_ID = #{orgId}
